- Finance: confirm acceptance of the revised burst pricing we discussed.

I've attached an updated runbook and a CSV mapping the opportunities to slot counts. Goal: a 30-minute alignment today so we can send Acme a mutual action plan (MAP) with clear dates.

Proposed time slots: 10:30 or 16:00 PT. If we meet, I will circulate a brief cadence and action owners.

Thanks —

Infra update:
- Current adjustable pool: 120 V100-equivalent slots across west/us-east with ~18 slots pending for other commitments. Headroom today ~102 slots.
- We can carve 60 slots for a guaranteed Dedicated small pool for the first 6 weeks, but that will require a 30% burst-rate premium for additional on-demand slots beyond the carve (pricing in runbook).
- Cross-region burst to us-east-1 adds ~6-12ms p50 token latency for our chat workloads; for embeddings the delta is ~2-4ms. Not material for background batch workloads, but worth flagging for low-latency interactive features.

Fallback partners: we have two partner pools (CloudCo partner + EdgeBurst) that can add another ~80 equivalent slots within 72 hours if we exercise a partner SLA. Partner pricing and lead times attached in the runbook.

I'll attach a short table mapping week vs delta-latency and expected per-token cost at default quantization. If we lock a 12-week reservation (Reserved Dedicated), we can avoid the burst premium for weeks 1–8.
